name: laa
description: Backend developer / tech lead / architect toolkit: fan-out agents, workflows, and self-improving skills.

plugins.name: laa
plugins.description: Core: /laa:explore, /laa:build, /laa:feature, /laa:fix, /laa:migrate, /laa:review, /laa:adopt, /laa:forge, /laa:retro, /laa:evolve + specialist agents, fan-out workflows, and hooks.

plugins.name: laa-go
plugins.description: Go stack pack: conventions skill and Go-specific reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET / C# stack pack: conventions skill and .NET-specific reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-python
plugins.description: Python stack pack: conventions skill and Python-specific reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-js
plugins.description: JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js) stack pack: conventions skill and JS/TS-specific reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-git
plugins.description: Git practice pack (any language): Conventional Commits, branch and PR conventions, and a history reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-docs
plugins.description: Docs practice pack (any language): README and onboarding conventions, and a docs-drift reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-docker
plugins.description: Docker practice pack (any language): dependencies, tests, and debugging in containers when Docker is available, and a local-environment drift reviewer.

plugins.name: laa-api
plugins.description: API practice pack (any language): OpenAPI as the contract, a Bruno collection as runnable docs and tests, and a reviewer for drift between code, spec, and collection.

plugins.name: laa-mods
plugins.description: Mods (TypeScript function hooks): blocks edits and commits on the default branch, tracks the running laa pipeline above the prompt and in the footer, /laa-help, panes for open learnings and review findings, and next-step suggestions.
